title: A pointer wake that opens the paper onto a second world
summary: Up to 140 wake points (750 ms life, radius from speed) painted as radial gradients into a 320 × 200 mask canvas; a GL composite shows a night scene only where the mask is open; the world renders at 0.62 scale every second frame and nothing renders at rest; fine pointers only
variants: A full second scene (a three.js world with its own camera) in place of the procedural night, rendered into the same reduced-scale target
Word mask: draw the hero's glyphs into the mask canvas as well, so the world shows inside the type
